title: Shipping a Prototype
description: Placeholder module (content-agnostic proof). Replaced when authored material lands.

objectives.label: Define what done means for a prototype
Put it in front of one real person

blocks.text: A prototype is not a small product. It is a question you can put in front of someone. Decide what it has to prove before you build it.

blocks.question: You want to know if people understand your sign-up flow. What is the smallest prototype?

options.label: Clickable screens of just the sign-up flow
The full product with accounts and payments
A written description of the idea

blocks.explanation: Clickable screens test understanding directly. The full product tests too many things at once; a description tests nothing people can do.

blocks.title: Punchline
blocks.text: One person using it teaches you more than ten people agreeing with you.
